label: external_cross_sections
purpose: External p+p cross sections at the NA49 beam momentum, used only as Gaussian nuisance anchors on the topology fractions (plan section 5.4 form; review record .collab/reviews/fable-speedup-2026-09-28.md, Section 4, run R51b). They are inputs with quoted uncertainties, never fit parameters.

sigma_inel_mb.provenance: house value of the NA49 p+p analyses at 158 GeV/c (inelastic normalization of the invariant cross sections); treated as exact in the fraction conversion

sigma_sd_total_mb.definition: single diffraction dissociation, both hemispheres summed (projectile plus target dissociation), M^2/s < 0.05
provenance: K. Goulianos, hep-ph/0407035, Fig. 1: the compilation of total single-diffraction cross sections for xi < 0.05 (Cool et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 47, 701 (1981), at 100 and 200 GeV/c; Albrow et al. and Armitage et al., ISR), with the plateau ('knee at 22 GeV') at about 7 mb
ISR small-angle review, arXiv:1206.3954: single diffraction 5.4 +- 1.0 mb at sqrt(s) = 23 GeV and 5.0 +- 1.0 mb at sqrt(s) = 31 GeV

the central value 6.5 mb with the 1.5 mb width covers both the 7 mb plateau reading and the 5.4 +- 1.0 mb ISR point; the figure values were read from a compilation, not from the original tables, so the width is deliberately generous
sigma_sd_total_mb.applied_by: R51 to R108: the run engine applied this value to the whole single-diffraction class, whose masses run to M^2/s = 0.89 (80% of it below 0.05 at epsilon = 0.56); superseded from R109 by sigma_sd_window_mb (the data audit of 2026-10-22, _knowledge/evidence/systematics-r108-2026-10-23.md)

sigma_sd_window_mb.definition: single diffraction dissociation, both hemispheres summed, M^2/s < 0.05, at the NA49 energy; the run engine (single_diffraction_window 0.05, from R109) applies it to the class's masses below the edge and takes the class share as this value over the class's window fraction at the fitted epsilon
provenance: K. Goulianos and J. Montanha, Phys. Rev. D 59, 114017 (1999), Table 7: Schamberger et al. 4.87, 4.96 and 4.94 +- 0.08 mb at sqrt(s) = 16.2, 17.6 and 19.1 GeV (normalization about 10%); Cool et al. 3.94 +- 0.20 mb at 14 GeV and 4.46 +- 0.25 mb at 20 GeV; the ISR 6.07 +- 0.17 and 6.5 +- 0.2 mb at 23 GeV

the central value is the Schamberger reading at sqrt(s) = 17.3 GeV; the 0.8 mb width covers the Cool et al. reading (about 4.2 mb) and the ISR normalization (the Fermilab and ISR data differ by 15-20% where they overlap, about 5.8 mb at this energy)
the data audit of 2026-10-22 (_knowledge/evidence/data-audit-2026-10-22.md), verified against the table

sigma_dd_mb.definition: double diffraction dissociation, central rapidity gap of at least 3 units (the CDF definition)
provenance: no direct measurement exists at sqrt(s) = 17 GeV; the renormalized-gap prediction band of K. Goulianos, hep-ph/0407035, Fig. 5, and the UA5 and CDF points at 200 to 1800 GeV bracket the low-energy value between about 1 mb (rapidity-gap estimate) and about 3 mb (Regge-model value quoted near sqrt(s) = 30 GeV)
the central value 1.5 mb with a 1.0 mb width is a prior band, not a measurement

f_sd_total.note: sigma_sd_total / sigma_inel; shared equally by sd_projectile and sd_target by beam-target symmetry

f_nd.note: 1 - f_sd_total - f_dd at the central values; fixed by the sum rule, never a separate nuisance

f_sd_window.note: sigma_sd_window / sigma_inel: the measured share of the single-diffraction class below M^2/s = 0.05 (from R109)

recorded_by: Claude Fable 5.1 session (review follow-up); values to be confirmed against the original publications by the plan owner
